name: github-workflows
//: The macOS routing/budget proofs over the workflows. No implicitDependencies on purpose: Nx counts an edit to a named target input as touching this project, so a change to any .github file, release-targets.toml or pyproject.toml selects it in the affected tier (as shell-tools' consumers do), while a crate-only edit, which none of its proofs read, does not.

budgets.//: llmlint: ignore[new_projects_keep_the_graph_uniform] The approved contract explicitly requires a budgets target depending on telemetry-producing test; these resource bounds are reported through onebudgetspec, separately from source lint.
